usage: The word '角' is a noun used to refer to the horn of an animal.
It can describe physical features on animals like goats, cows, or deer.
You can use '角' in singular or plural form depending on the context.
It often appears in phrases describing shape, size, or condition of the horn.
'角' can also be used metaphorically to describe sharp corners in some contexts.
